state:
Goal `core-validate-and-1-more`: `Core\Validate::isAscii`, `isDomain`, `isEmail` and `isMac` are finished, each with a plain card and every proof.
`isIp` and `isPrintable` still owe everything but their Novis tests, and their cards are still in the dense "Answers whether …" voice.
`Core\Xml` (the check `dossier-core-xml`) has not been started: it owes its class card and all proofs for `parse`, `reader` and `writer`.
The floor checks for `Core\Json`, `Core\Test`, `Core\Test\Response` and `Core\Test\SentRequest` were red only because an uncommitted edit to `json.rs` and `test.rs` (the `nvs_runtime::stack_pointer` change, with `safepoint.rs`, `wiring.rs`, `lib.rs`, `perf_guards.rs`, `ci.yml`, `serve.rs`, `mysql.rs`) moved their implementation text. Their figures are re-recorded against that text. That edit is not this loop's, and no commit here stages it.
The `Core\Regex\Match` floor check is fixed: a string compared with itself no longer reads its bytes.
Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **`Core\Validate::isIp`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). No Rust test exists: write one marked `// covers: Core\Validate::isIp`, in the shape of `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:831`. Rewrite the card at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:283` in the plain voice. `docs/examples/core/Validate/isMac/` is the model. The bench declares `allocations 0` and `calls 0`, indexes with `(($total + $i) % 3) as int` and adds a multiple of 3 on every path. `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Validate'` writes the figure after the last edit to `validate.rs`.

**`Core\Validate::isPrintable`** — the same list, and no Rust test either: write one in the shape of `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:831`. Rewrite the card at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/validate.rs:337`.

backlog: `Core\Xml` class card and the proofs of `parse`, `reader` and `writer` — check `dossier-core-xml`; the card goes above the class's `CLASS` row, and the name leaves `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`.
